comparison.objective: Set a robot-joint timing belt to specified tension and secure its motor mount.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sliding mount while tightening bolts and checking belt deflection.
comparison.success_condition: Specified post-release deflection, clamp load, stability, seating, alignment, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: Tension adjustment and fastening test elastic preload and metrology, not loose-media separation.
